explanation: Hergé is a pen name: the French pronunciation of R. G., the reversed initials of Georges Remi. Peyo created the Smurfs, while Goscinny and Uderzo made Asterix.

claims.text: Tintin was created by the Belgian cartoonist Hergé.
Peyo created the Smurfs, and René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo created Asterix; none of them created Tintin.
Hergé was the pen name of Georges Remi, from the French pronunciation of his reversed initials, R. G.
